# Hi, I'm Jan Niklas 👋

Full-stack developer (C#/.NET, Angular, Node.js) with a serious focus on **agentic AI** — building agents that are actually reliable, and the tooling around them.

## What I'm working on

- **Agent frameworks & tooling** — OpenClaw, Hermes, LangChain/LangGraph; self-hosted LLMs running as MCP servers on local GPUs
- **Remote session attach for Hermes** — live-attach to agent sessions over a private network (SSE streaming, pairing-code auth, desktop + CLI) — contributed openly at [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)
- **Semantic image search** — a local C# console app that catalogues image collections with Ollama vision + embeddings and searches them semantically (see pinned repo)
- **Reinforcement learning** — trained a MaskablePPO agent to play Balatro as my bachelor's thesis (285-dim state space, Lua mod integration)
